feed.text: Demand for Astra is really unprecedented. We're pulling all the levers possible to sustain the demand, but I've not seen anything like it until now and we went through very steep growth before. Priority will always be to keep excellent service for existing users, but we might have to pause new Pro subscriptions for a bit if this continues.
feed.text_zh: Astra 需求前所未有，OpenAI 正尽力扩容并优先保障现有用户；如果需求持续，可能会暂时暂停新的 Pro 订阅。
feed.summary_zh: Astra 需求前所未有，如持续可能暂时暂停新的 Pro 订阅

feed.text: Looking at this 28 page deck right now where Codex is keeping track of all the individual launches. Each one of them I can't wait to see what people do with it. Brought to you by an incredible team (and Astra)
feed.text_zh: Codex 正用一份 28 页的材料跟踪多项独立发布；Tibo 表示很期待看到用户如何使用这些由团队和 Astra 推动的新功能。
feed.summary_zh: Codex 正跟踪多项独立发布，后续还有一系列 Astra 相关上线内容

feed.text: All reset for everyone. Enjoy the week with Astra.
feed.text_zh: 已为所有人完成全局额度重置，可以继续使用 Astra。
feed.summary_zh: 已为所有人完成全局额度重置，可以继续使用 Astra

feed.text: Reminder that GPT-6 Astra on Low can be better than 5.6 Sol on High
feed.text_zh: 提醒：GPT-6 Astra 的 Low 推理强度表现可优于 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 High。
feed.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 的 Low 推理强度表现可优于 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 High

feed.text: We will do a global reset of the usage for all paid subscriptions so that you can keep enjoying Astra after burning through all of it doing fun 3D modeling in blender. The work week is about to start. Lands around 6pm PST today.
feed.text_zh: 将为所有付费订阅执行全局额度重置，让用户继续使用 Astra，预计当天约太平洋时间下午 6 点生效。
feed.summary_zh: 所有付费订阅将执行全局额度重置，预计当天约太平洋时间下午 6 点生效

feed.text: We've made some improvements that improve usage on the long tail for power users of Astra when logged in with your ChatGPT account. No change in quality and in some cases up to 3-4X less usage being drawn from the subscription.
feed.text_zh: 针对使用 ChatGPT 账号登录的 Astra 重度用户，已优化长尾使用量；质量不变，部分情况下订阅用量消耗可减少约 3–4 倍。
feed.summary_zh: Astra 重度用户用量已优化，部分情况下订阅消耗可减少约 3–4 倍

feed.text: To calibrate, GPT-6 Astra on low performs better than GPT-5.6 Sol on high. If you were using Sol high before, move down to low or medium for Astra.
feed.text_zh: Astra 的 Low 推理强度表现优于 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 High；原来使用 Sol High 的用户可改用 Astra Low 或 Medium。
feed.summary_zh: Astra Low 表现优于 GPT-5.6 Sol High，可优先改用 Low 或 Medium

feed.text: OK nevermind, systems are proving more scalable than expected and Astra is now rolled out to all Plus and Business users too. Hope you have a blast with it!
feed.text_zh: 系统扩展能力好于预期，Astra 已提前完成向所有 Plus 和 Business 用户的推送。
feed.summary_zh: Astra 已完成向所有 Plus 和 Business 用户的推送

feed.text: Some Plus and Business users won't yet get access to Astra today, we've got you covered with a banked reset. Lands by end of day and if you create your account by 8pm PT then you'll get it too.
feed.text_zh: 部分 Plus 和 Business 用户当天仍未获得 Astra，将收到一次 banked reset；预计当天结束前到账，太平洋时间晚上 8 点前创建账号也可获得。
feed.summary_zh: 部分 Plus 和 Business 用户将获一次 banked reset，预计当天结束前到账

feed.text: GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users alongside the API. I’ve been using it to build apps, LEGO models, and 3D scenes. Here are five things that changed how I use Codex.
feed.text_zh: GPT-6 Astra 已向所有 Pro、Enterprise 和 Business Premium 用户及 API 开放；Dominik 分享了其在 Codex 中构建应用、LEGO 模型和 3D 场景的使用经验。
feed.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 已向 Pro、Enterprise、Business Premium 用户及 API 开放

feed.text: GPT-6 Astra is now available in the API. It’s also available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users. Access in ChatGPT Work and Codex may take a few days to reach Plus and all Business users.
feed.text_zh: GPT-6 Astra 已在 API 上线，并向 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 的 Pro、Enterprise、Business Premium 用户开放；Plus 和其他 Business 用户可能还需几天。
feed.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 已上线 API，并向 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 的部分付费用户开放

feed.text: We will give one banked reset for every day you don't have access to Astra on your paid ChatGPT plan, starting today. First one will land in ~3 hours.
feed.text_zh: 从当天起，付费 ChatGPT 用户每多一天无法使用 Astra，就会获得一次 banked reset；第一次预计约 3 小时后到账。
feed.summary_zh: 未获得 Astra 的付费用户每天可获一次 banked reset，第一次约 3 小时后到账

feed.text: Across the plans Astra will be included in the normal usage allocation and you will be able to use 100% of it towards Astra.
feed.text_zh: 各付费方案中，Astra 计入正常使用额度，并且可以把全部正常额度用于 Astra。
feed.summary_zh: Astra 计入正常使用额度，可将全部额度用于 Astra

feed.text: We are starting to release GPT-6 Astra and we are doing it as carefully and quickly as possible. It was very important to us that we bring it to all Plus users and not only Pro, Business and Enterprise. It will take a few days for the rollout to complete and behind the scenes many novel systems will operate at scale for the first time and we are bringing a lot of compute up. It is pure magic.
feed.text_zh: GPT-6 Astra 开始逐步发布，目标覆盖所有 Plus 用户以及 Pro、Business、Enterprise；完整推送预计需要数天。
feed.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 开始逐步发布，完整推送预计需要数天并覆盖所有 Plus 用户

feed.text: We’re bringing GPT-6 Astra to where you build very very soon. GPT-6 Astra is rolling out today to a limited set of organizations and over the coming days will become available to all ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, as well as through OpenAI API and AWS.
feed.text_zh: GPT-6 Astra 开始向少量组织推出，接下来几天扩展至 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise，并进入 OpenAI API 和 AWS。
feed.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 开始分批推出，并将在数日内扩展至各付费方案、API 和 AWS
